source.name: NFSBiH: New Kits for a New World Cup Story of Bosnia and Herzegovina
source.quote: The Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Federation and Kelme proudly present the new kits of the Bosnia and Herzegovina "A" national team
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers (same as jordan-2026-home). Every placement checked: NFSBiH's launch studio shots (front and back of both kits, republished by Football Kit News 2026-05-25) and NFSBiH's own match galleries (Switzerland-BiH 1-4, 2026-06-18, away kit; BiH-Qatar 3-1, 2026-06-24, home kit incl. team line-up) show only the Kelme paw logo and the NFSBiH crest on the chest, the FIFA World Cup patch on the right sleeve, name and number on the back, and only the number and Kelme logo on the shorts. No commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Kelme's navy 2026 World Cup home shirt for Bosnia and Herzegovina carries only the Kelme logo, the NFSBiH crest and white-and-yellow pinstripes; the federation's launch and match photos show clean sleeves and plain navy shorts (NFSBiH announcement, 2026-05-25).
